newsitem.title: CHINA: France's Danone in $38 mln China beer JV.
newsitem.headline: France's Danone in $38 mln China beer JV.

text.p: French food group Danone has pumped the equivalent of 320 million yuan ($38.55 million) into a new brewery joint venture in China's central city of Wuhan, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
Danone held a 60 percent stake in the Wuhan Euro-Dongxihu Brewery Co Ltd, which was set up on Thursday -- the same day French President Jacques Chirac began a state visit to China.
The new brewery venture planned to introduce a state-of-the-art bottling line in the near future, Xinhua said but gave no details of the brands that would be produced.
Danone's new partner, Wuhan Dongxihu Brewery Corp, was China's fifth largest beer producer, with an output of 370,000 tonnes of beer a year, the agency said but did not elaborate.
